summary: Backend-only pytest run for finance bulk-delete, expense paid_from_account_id, and accounting reversal correctness (iteration 202). 15/15 tests passed against the public preview URL.
critical_code_review_comments: financial.py is ~1230 lines — approaching the 700-line split threshold; consider splitting into donations.py / expenses.py / budgets.py / assets.py modules for maintainability.

Bulk-delete endpoints for donations/expenses/assets currently return only {deleted: N} while accounting/entries bulk-delete returns {deleted, skipped_posted}. Consider a consistent shape (e.g. always include not_found count) so the FE can treat responses uniformly.

list_expenses does not project out _id (uses {'_id': 0}) — that's fine, but paid_from_account_id has no index; if expense volume grows and the FE filters by paid_from_account_id in future, add an index.

Reversal endpoint uses `require_director` while bulk-delete uses `require_admin` — role model is consistent but worth calling out in API docs. The idempotency check on reverse is well-implemented and confirmed working.
Non-existent IDs in accounting bulk-delete are correctly ignored (not counted as skipped_posted). Verified in test_bulk_delete_drafts_but_skips_posted.
seed_data_creation: Test creates and cleans up its own TEST_ prefixed donations, expenses, assets, budgets, and accounting entries. Journal/account seed via POST /api/accounting/seed only invoked if none exist (was not needed on this run).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 7 flows in scope verified end-to-end: (1) accounting reversal marks original is_reversed=true with reversed_by/reversed_at; (2) reverse is idempotent — same reversal ID returned on 2nd call; (3) GET /api/accounting/entries hides BOTH original and reversal by default; (4) ?include_reversed=true surfaces both; (5) expenses accept + persist paid_from_account_id (verified in create response AND GET list); (6) donations/expenses/assets/budgets bulk-delete work, return {deleted: N}, and return 400 on empty ids; (7) accounting entries bulk-delete deletes drafts, skips posted, ignores non-existent ids, returns {deleted, skipped_posted}. Frontend UI was intentionally not tested per the request (backend only).
